findings: Both complete games replay exactly from ordinary setup through life-force victory, totaling 4616 native commands and 450 compared checkpoints.
Version 8 compares current ship armor, maneuver and hyperspeed in addition to power, ability, forfeit, crew roles, ordered piles, attachments, battle losses/destinies and final result.

Five printed ship weapons are exercised: SW-4 Ion Cannon, Ion Cannon, Quad Laser Cannon, Proton Torpedoes and Turbolaser Battery. Three just-drawn maneuver Interrupts use actual observed primary targets.
The ion game includes two successful ionizations and misses. The laser game includes misses and failed destiny draws. No production runtime change was necessary for these paths.
harnessNotes: Ordinary random initial shuffle, exact custom 60-card lists, legal offered choices only; no in-game state changes or corrections.

Exploratory runs 1 and 2 did not fire ship weapons. Retained runs 3 and 4 prioritize legal weapon deployment and keep fleets at Tatooine long enough for battle; run 4 prioritizes laser weapons. Each exact executed harness is archived.
All 6820 production reference files compared byte-for-byte with the pinned source archive and remain unchanged.
limits: Selected paths, not exhaustive card/deck/timing certification. Production admission remains closed.
